drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel, thank you for flagging the inadvertent inclusion and for refraining from use or further disclosure. We assert privilege and work-product protection over the inadvertently included material and request its prompt return or destruction, including copies, or sequestration pending resolution of the claim under the applicable rules and any governing order. Please do not use or disclose the material pending resolution, and please confirm the steps taken. If Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(b)(5)(B) governs, please follow its procedures, including reasonable retrieval efforts if the material was already disclosed. We will preserve the material pending resolution. No waiver is intended.

The replacement copy removes the inadvertently included material. Please use that copy going forward, subject to the foregoing preservation and sequestration procedures.

We propose serving supplemental, request-specific responses within seven calendar days after service of the clean replacement. Each will state the applicable objections and whether responsive materials are being withheld under each objection. We propose beginning rolling production 14 calendar days after that service and completing it within 45 calendar days after that service. Any required privilege log would be served with the final production, no later than that 45-day deadline, subject to any earlier deadline imposed by applicable rules or order. Please confirm whether this schedule is acceptable.

edits.text: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production

1. PRIVILEGE OBJECTION. Defendant objects to disclosure of information protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or other applicable protection. This statement does not substitute for request-specific responses. Within seven calendar days after service of this clean replacement, Defendant will serve supplemental responses identifying, for each request, the objections asserted and whether responsive materials are being withheld under each objection. Any withholding based on privilege or protection will be identified as required by applicable rules and any governing order.

2. PRODUCTION. Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control following a reasonable search, except to the extent withheld under an objection identified in its request-specific responses. Defendant proposes beginning rolling production 14 calendar days after service of this clean replacement and completing production within 45 calendar days after that service. These proposed dates are subject to agreement or court order and do not extend any existing deadline absent agreement or court approval where required. Defendant will confer promptly regarding production format.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent required by applicable rules and any governing order, Defendant will provide a privilege log identifying responsive materials withheld on privilege or protection grounds without disclosing protected information. Defendant proposes serving the required log with the final production, no later than 45 calendar days after service of this clean replacement, subject to any earlier deadline imposed by applicable rules or governing order.
